method: I used my current project idea to identify possible accessibility barriers. I then evaluated my Practice Grid by writing what I did well, what I needed to improve, and how to improve. Finally, I discussed my reflections with Sam.
related_work: In class, we discussed three aspects of accessibility: language and understanding, physical access, and intersectionality. These ideas helped me consider how different audiences might experience my work. I also reflected on my Practice Grid, particularly my values and principles, and how they could influence my design decisions.
conclusion_future_work: This week helped me identify both my strengths and the areas I need to improve. I want to explore more references and experiment with different technologies before deciding on my final direction. More importantly, I need to understand why I want to create something, rather than only focusing on how to make it.
results_discussion: Through the accessibility exercise, I realised that my current sound-based project might not be fully accessible to people who are deaf or hard of hearing. Some ASMR sounds may also make certain audiences uncomfortable. These are challenges I need to consider as the project develops.In my self-assessment, I recognised that I have a clearer interest in digital and interactive experiences, but my creative direction is still quite broad. During the peer discussion, Sam suggested that if my work involves programming, I should identify the programming language I need and start learning it in advance.I also began questioning whether my current idea is meaningful enough. Although I have some ideas about the media I want to use, I am still unsure what I really want to explore.
title: creative industry research - week 6
introduction: This week, we explored accessibility and reflected on our creative practices. Through the accessibility exercise, Practice Grid self-assessment, and peer discussion, I began to identify the challenges in my current work. I also realised that I am still uncertain about my creative direction and what I really want to explore.
